name: Holcus 16D Paths Gallery
tagline: The original SVG outputs of ptol.c, Holcus's 16-dimensional path papers: each prompt is projected onto the 16 sedenion basis elements; the spokes are e₀…e₁₅ (σ = ½ ring dashed), node distance is the scalar, the words on the spokes are the prompt hashed. Unmodified copies of ~/.ptolemy/papers/*.svg. Stays in VAPMIP.

groups.name: “what should we call you”
groups.blurb: Seven runs on the same prompt.

groups.name: “why is the mass gap 1/root(2000)”
groups.blurb: Six runs; the prompt is the title text of each paper.

groups.name: “it is sung”
groups.blurb: One prompt, kept with its bitmap/HTML siblings in ~/.ptolemy/papers.

groups.name: Command-line test runs
groups.blurb: Help and flag runs of ptol.c (the prompt is the flag text).

groups.name: Pathway diff
groups.blurb: The 16-channel delta between the two most recent papers (the pathway skill).
